blurb: Westlock County and area residents are welcoming the warmer weather and preparing for enjoyable outdoor activities, including going to Long Island Lake Municipal Campground on a hot summer day. As campground managers and service providers, it is our responsibility to take the greatest care to provide our staff and campers with a safe and enjoyable environment in which to camp.
